name: Quaternius Animated Dinosaurs
author: Quaternius

exclude.Trex: Held back by the owner: its mouth is modelled open with a row of teeth and the skeleton has no jaw to close it (docs/kit2-packs-plan.md). It ships in no form until the head is re-modelled.

notes: Dino Valley 1.0.0 ships five of the six: Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Parasaurolophus, Apatosaurus, Velociraptor (closed mouths, no teeth showing; looked at face on and side on beside a hero).
Kept clips: idle, walk, run, jump. Dropped from every model: Attack and Death (the Apatosaurus file carries a clip misnamed Stegosaurus_Death; it is dropped like the others).
The pack's own colours are dark olive and brown: Dino Valley gives each material one bright colour (the colours step in its theme.def.json).
source: branch asset-packs, folder dinosaurs/ (uploaded by the owner, November 2026)
